description: This file defines the SeedData class responsible for seeding initial data into a SQLite database for a Flutter expense tracker app. It inserts categories, sample transactions for current and previous months, and budgets for categories per month.

classes.name: SeedData
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to seed initial app data into the database.

methods.name: ensureSeeded
methods.description: Inserts default seed data including categories, transactions, budgets, and seed status flag if not already seeded.
